game.title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition
game.blurb: DC superhero fighting game from NetherRealm Studios (RAWG also lists High Voltage Software and Armature Studio), published by Warner Bros. Interactive, released 2013-11-12. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Arcade, Fighting. Chapters follow the game modes named in the Steam achievements.

chapters.title: Story Mode
chapters.summary: Completing half, then all, of Story Mode and winning every story minigame.

chapters.title: Battle Mode
chapters.summary: Classic Battle with any character and with all of them, and finishing Battle Mode.

chapters.title: S.T.A.R. Lab Missions
chapters.summary: Completing missions, earning stars and three-starring every mission.

chapters.title: Online and Multiplayer
chapters.summary: Online, ranked and King of the Hill matches, online practice with a friend, and multiplayer wins with throws, timeouts and interactables.

chapters.title: Archives, Hero Card and Levels
chapters.summary: Costumes and everything in the Archives, the Hero Card, backgrounds, icons, portraits and reaching levels 10 and 100.

chapters.title: Techniques, Characters and Arenas
chapters.summary: The tutorial and practice, clashes, super moves, special and Meter Burn moves, combos, stage transitions and interactions, and character feats with Batman, Green Arrow and Deathstroke.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected Ultimate Edition entry (id 17540); RAWG keeps the 2013 "Injustice: Gods Among Us" (id 211) separately. Steam app 242700 is the Ultimate Edition itself ("Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition" in the store list; its schema is named "Cronus", an internal codename); no Steam app for the original edition was found in the store list. StrategyWiki has no page under the Ultimate Edition title; "Injustice: Gods Among Us" is at completion stage 0. Twelve character pages are written (Aquaman, Ares, Bane, Batgirl, Batman, Black Adam, Catwoman, Cyborg, Deathstroke, Doomsday, Green Arrow, The Flash, about 7,100 to 11,800 characters each), plus Controls and Achievements and trophies; Walkthrough, Gameplay, Characters, Battles, S.T.A.R. Lab Missions, Archives, DLC and the other character pages are linked but not written, so it has no walkthrough to use. injustice.fandom.com answers the API under "Injustice: Gods Among Us" with about 119 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 50 Steam achievements is hidden. "I Conquered All" says it excludes DLC missions; no achievement names an added fighter. "Defeat a Survivor" and "Vote Correctly in a KOTH match" sit among the online achievements in the Steam list, so they are in the online chapter.
